name: Obsidian Vault
description: Search and reference local Obsidian notes in Cindy, follow wikilinks, save conversations, and add entries to your daily note.
whenToUse: Use when the user wants to search, read, create, organize, or update Obsidian notes, vaults, Daily Notes, wikilinks, backlinks, frontmatter properties, tags, or Canvas boards, or capture chat insights into their second brain.

vault_status.description: Inspect registered local Obsidian vaults, active vault statistics (note count, wikilinks, open tasks, top tags, daily/inbox folders, recent notes), and Obsidian CLI status.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path; defaults to active vault.

/properties/refresh.description: Optional boolean to force rescanning disk index.

search_notes.description: Search notes by keywords, folder, tag, and property. Returns ranked pages with body match locations.

/properties/query.description: Space-separated search keywords matched across title, aliases, tags, headings, and body.

/properties/folder.description: Restrict search to a subfolder prefix.

/properties/tag.description: Filter by tag or nested tag prefix (without leading #).

/properties/propertyKey.description: Filter by YAML frontmatter property key.

/properties/propertyValue.description: Substring required in the frontmatter property value.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered target vault ID or name.

/properties/cursor.description: Pass nextCursor unchanged to continue with the same query and page size.

/properties/maxMatchesPerNote.description: Maximum body matches per note, 1–20, default 8.

read_note.description: Read a full Obsidian note, heading section, or ^block ID. The heading list includes complete heading paths.

/properties/heading.description: Optional Markdown heading to read only that section.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered target vault ID or name.

/properties/headingPath.description: Full heading path, such as ["Project A", "Summary"]. Mutually exclusive with heading and blockId.

/properties/blockId.description: Obsidian block ID, such as ^meeting-summary. Mutually exclusive with heading and headingPath.

write_note.description: Create or edit a note, heading, block, or frontmatter. Overwriting an existing note or moving it to trash requires confirmation.

/properties/mode.description: Use a heading edit mode with heading or headingPath, or a block edit mode with blockId.

/properties/heading.description: Target Markdown heading when using append-heading, prepend-heading, or replace-section.

/properties/content.description: Markdown content to write or insert.

/properties/frontmatter.description: Top-level scalar/array YAML frontmatter keys to patch (null deletes a key).

/properties/tags.description: Tags to merge into frontmatter tags.

/properties/idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate appends on retry.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered target vault ID or name.

/properties/headingPath.description: Full heading path, such as ["Project A", "Summary"]. Mutually exclusive with heading and blockId.

/properties/blockId.description: Obsidian block ID, such as ^meeting-summary. Mutually exclusive with heading and headingPath.

daily_note.description: Read, initialize from template, or atomically append timestamped entries/tasks to an Obsidian Daily Note.

/properties/action.description: read (read-only), ensure (create if missing), append, or add-task.

/properties/date.description: Optional strict YYYY-MM-DD local calendar date.

/properties/content.description: Entry or task text for append / add-task.

/properties/heading.description: Optional heading section inside the daily note.

/properties/timestamp.description: Prepend HH:mm timestamp on append (default true).

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered target vault ID or name.

graph_links.description: Traverse Obsidian knowledge graph links: inspect outlinks, embeds, backlinks, unlinked mentions, and 2-hop neighbors, or list vault hubs, orphans, and tag distributions.

/properties/mode.description: Graph query mode: note, hubs, orphans, or tags.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered target vault ID or name.

canvas_ops.description: List, read, create, or losslessly upsert Obsidian .canvas boards (preserving group/subpath/edge attributes; overwrite requires confirmation).

/properties/action.description: list, read, create, upsert, overwrite, or write.

/properties/removeNodeIds.description: Node IDs to remove during upsert.

/properties/removeEdgeIds.description: Edge IDs to remove during upsert.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered target vault ID or name.

open_in_obsidian.description: Open a verified vault note or canvas in the desktop Obsidian app via CLI or exact-path obsidian:// URI.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered target vault ID or name.

open_workbench.description: Open the interactive Obsidian Vault workbench UI to browse notes, inspect backlinks, capture notes, or view today's Daily Note.

/properties/mode.description: Initial tab: browse, capture, or daily.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered target vault ID or name.

complete_notes.description: App-only provider for @ composer completion returning disambiguated Obsidian wikilinks.

pick_vault_dir.description: App-only helper to register and switch default Obsidian vault folder via system picker.

list_notes.description: List files and folders within a registered vault by relative folder, depth, and optional file extension. Reads directory metadata only.

replace_in_note.description: Replace literal text within the body, a heading section, or a block. Defaults to a unique match. Preview and check match counts before writing. Frontmatter is preserved.

/properties/headingPath.description: Full heading path, such as ["Project A", "Summary"]. Mutually exclusive with heading and blockId.

/properties/blockId.description: Obsidian block ID, such as ^meeting-summary. Mutually exclusive with heading and headingPath.

manage_tags.description: List, add, or remove complete frontmatter tags in a Markdown note. Matches ignore case and leave the body and other properties intact.

write_receipt.description: Workbench only. Check whether a previous note or daily note request was saved, without modifying the vault.

set_vault_write_policy.description: Workbench only. Save a registered vault’s read-only flag and write folders after Cindy confirmation.
